CustomField.description: Optional group number for OR-based condition grouping. Conditions with the same group number are AND-joined within the group. Groups are OR-joined between each other. Conditions with no group (null) are root-level AND filters that apply globally across all groups. Example: Group 1 = RecordType Standard + Priority High, Group 2 = RecordType Premium + Region West. Result: root_filters AND (group1 OR group2).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Leave blank for standard AND filtering. Set a group number (1, 2, 3...) to create OR-grouped condition sets.
CustomField.label: Condition Group
